title: Build 1.60.1.70753 and the November 2 development notes: class damage raised across the game

source.label: Blizzard: WoW Forever Beta Development Notes, updated November 2

lines.title: Dragonfire Potion and Caustic Smog Potion can't crit
lines.note: Both spells are flagged Can't Crit, so neither the hit nor the damage over time crits. Down 0.1 to 1.6 at 180 s.

lines.title: Faerie Fire in Cat Form has a 1 sec global cooldown and a 6 sec cooldown
lines.note: Cat Form's passive shortens it, as it makes it free. In Bear Form it keeps the 1.5 sec global cooldown, also with the 6 sec cooldown. Up 2.0 at 180 s for the cat that keeps Faerie Fire up.

lines.title: Warrior talents reworked: Slam on a 15 sec cooldown (Improved Slam takes 2.5 / 5 sec off), Two-Handed Weapon Specialization 2 / 4 / 6%, Flurry 10 / 20 / 30% in 3 points, and the new Reckless Swings and Improved Whirlwind
lines.note: Improved Tactical Mastery (5 / 10 / 15 Rage) and Bloodthrill (10 / 20%) take fewer points, Flurry no longer needs Death Wish, and Bloodthirst does. Every warrior talent string changed. Client 1.60.1.70753 doesn't carry these yet, so the sim uses the notes' values.

source.label: Blizzard: WoW Forever Beta Development Notes, updated November 2

lines.title: Warrior presets re-picked for the new tree; Arms and Dragonkin Slam ahead of Mortal Strike, every build casts Reckless Swings on cooldown
lines.note: At 180 s: Fury 1041.5 to 1153.0, two-hand Fury 1044.4 to 1173.3, Arms 1008.7 to 1097.7, Arms vs Dragonkin 1050.3 to 1142.2.

lines.title: Arms warrior presets are Orc (were Undead)
Two-hand Fury is the warrior's default build, in place of dual-wield Fury
lines.note: It is now the warrior's highest build at 180 s.

lines.title: Hunter damage raised: Aimed Shot, Arcane Shot, Serpent Sting and Sniper Shot hit harder; Aspect of the Hawk gives 110 and Trueshot Aura 100 ranged attack power; Barrage 5 / 10 / 15%, Lightning Reflexes 3% Agility a rank
lines.note: Arcane Shot's 15% of ranged attack power and Serpent Sting's 5% a tick come from the November 2 notes, which the hotfix's rows don't show. All traps now share one 30 sec cooldown (no preset lays a trap).

lines.title: Hunter rotations re-searched: Marksmanship and Lone Wolf cast Aimed Shot at any mana, Beast Mastery takes Improved Arcane Shot 4 for a point of Improved Stings
lines.note: At 180 s: Lone Wolf 1089.9 to 1313.7, Marksmanship 1066.3 to 1254.3, Beast Mastery 1046.5 to 1195.6, Survival 1024.6 to 1041.2, with the hotfix above.

lines.title: Feral damage raised: Shred 200%, Claw 140% and Ravage 435% weapon damage; Rip, Rake and Ferocious Bite 25% more; Rend and Tear 3% a point
lines.note: Ferocious Bite's extra damage per Energy is unchanged. Feral at 180 s: 942.5 to 1131.1. Client 1.60.1.70753 doesn't carry these yet, so the sim uses the notes' values.

source.label: Blizzard: WoW Forever Beta Development Notes, updated November 2

lines.title: Starfire deals 40% more base damage
lines.note: Balance at 180 s: 892.3 to 951.5; the Wrath build gains 8.5. Client 1.60.1.70753 doesn't carry it yet, so the sim uses the notes' value.

source.label: Blizzard: WoW Forever Beta Development Notes, updated November 2

lines.title: New passive Poised: out of combat at full Energy, the next Energy ability costs 10 less
lines.note: Rogues' Composure adds 5 a rank. The Feral opener is a Clearcasting Ravage, which is free already, so Feral gains nothing.

lines.title: Vengeance stacks up to 5 times (was 3)
lines.note: About +45 DPS at 180 s on every Retribution preset. Client 1.60.1.70753 doesn't carry it yet, so the sim uses the notes' value.

source.label: Blizzard: WoW Forever Beta Development Notes, updated November 2

lines.title: Two-Handed Weapon Specialization raises all Holy damage, not just Physical
lines.note: Consecration, Exorcism, Hammer of Wrath, Holy Wrath and Holy Shock now gain it too: +8 at 180 s on twisting and sub-Holy, +15 on Retribution Shock. Client 1.60.1.70753 doesn't carry it yet, so the sim uses the notes' value.

source.label: Blizzard: WoW Forever Beta Development Notes, updated November 2

lines.title: Retribution vs Undead: Consecration first, and Hammer of Wrath at the top in the execute phase
Shadow Word: Death costs the priest 30% of maximum health when the target survives (was 10%), and nothing on a miss
lines.note: No preset's damage depends on the priest's health.

lines.title: Smite priest takes Spiritual Guidance and Shadow Focus in place of Power Infusion and Twin Disciplines
lines.note: Smite at 180 s: 762.0 to 781.0.

lines.title: Rogue talents reworked: Murder, Quietus, Cutthroat and Thousand Cuts removed; Aggression 5 / 10 / 15%, Flawless Execution 15, Ghostly Strike opens Ambush and Garrote outside Stealth, Hemorrhage raises Garrote, Coup de Grace raises Death Mark
lines.note: Lethality, Relentless Strikes, Seal Fate, Dual Wield Specialization and Opportunity change ranks, Blood Splatter is new, and Efficient Strikes covers Hemorrhage. Every rogue talent string changed. Client 1.60.1.70753 doesn't carry these yet, so the sim uses the notes' values.

source.label: Blizzard: WoW Forever Beta Development Notes, updated November 2

lines.title: New rogue ability Shank; Venom is now a passive on Shank, poisons gain twice the attack power, Mutilate deals 90% weapon damage
lines.note: Flash of Steel adds Energy to Shank and cuts its cooldown; Boot Knife gives it 2 combo points. Client 1.60.1.70753 doesn't carry these yet, so the sim uses the notes' values.

source.label: Blizzard: WoW Forever Beta Development Notes, updated November 2

lines.title: Rogue presets re-picked for the new tree, with Shank in every rotation; Subtlety now takes Death Mark and Boot Knife
lines.note: At 180 s: Combat Swords 780.4 to 963.5, Seal Fate Swords 745.5 to 957.0, Combat Daggers 789.6 to 946.7, Seal Fate Daggers 751.9 to 920.7, Subtlety 731.8 to 881.7, Mutilate 742.7 to 866.1.

lines.title: Subtlety rogue preset is Night Elf (was Undead)
Combat Swords is the rogue's default build
lines.note: It is now the rogue's highest build at 180 s.

lines.title: Rogue presets vs Humanoid dropped
lines.note: With Murder gone they sim exactly like their base builds.

lines.title: Lightning Bolt and every shock deal more, Lightning Overload 10 / 20 / 30%
lines.note: Lightning Bolt ranks 4 to 10 are raised (rank 10 by 76%) and the shocks take their original base damage. Elemental at 180 s: 767.6 to 970.1 with the talents below. Client 1.60.1.70753 doesn't carry these yet, so the sim uses the notes' values.

source.label: Blizzard: WoW Forever Beta Development Notes, updated November 2

lines.title: Stormstrike deals 150% weapon damage on a 6 sec cooldown, Maelstrom Weapon procs twice as often, Mental Dexterity 150%, Flurry 30%
lines.note: Enhancement at 180 s: 883.0 to 1159.2 with the talents below. Client 1.60.1.70753 doesn't carry these yet, so the sim uses the notes' values.

source.label: Blizzard: WoW Forever Beta Development Notes, updated November 2

lines.title: Shaman talents: Lava Burst removed and Call of Thunder in its place, Elemental Mastery becomes Lightning Mastery, Totemic Projection becomes Totemic Call, Improved Ghost Wolf moves down; Chain Lightning a 2.5 sec cast
lines.note: Every Enhancement talent string changed.

source.label: Blizzard: WoW Forever Beta Development Notes, updated November 2

lines.title: Hotfix: Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning and the shocks take their launch damage
lines.note: Launch realm hotfixes set every rank's damage, replacing the sim's reading of the development notes. Lightning Bolt rank 10 deals 342 to 381 at 60 (the notes' 78% of the original gave 334 to 372), and ranks 1 to 3 a little more. Chain Lightning rank 4 deals 494 to 552 to its first target (485 to 539 from the notes' 145% of Lightning Bolt) and its ranks cost 245 / 360 / 425 / 495 mana. The top shock ranks barely move; lower ranks deal a few percent more.

lines.title: Shaman presets re-picked for the new tree
lines.note: Enhancement drops Earth Shock ahead of Lightning Bolt, Elemental downranks Lightning Bolt when mana runs short, and the Lava Burst lines are gone.

lines.title: Enhancement holds Earth Shock up to 1 sec for the Stormstrike mark
lines.note: About even on the Enhancement preset and a small gain with Improved Ghost Wolf.

lines.title: Wrack deals twice the spell damage a tick and more base damage; Shadow and Flame 4% a point (was 2%)
lines.note: Destruction at 180 s: 997.5 to 1063.4. Demons' health from the warlock's Stamina drops to 2 a point. Client 1.60.1.70753 doesn't carry these yet, so the sim uses the notes' values.

source.label: Blizzard: WoW Forever Beta Development Notes, updated November 2

lines.title: Affliction warlock reworked: deep Affliction with Wrack as the main spell, the Imp sacrificed and no demon out
lines.note: Affliction at 180 s: 1034.1 as an Undead. The Shadow Bolt Affliction build with Nightfall, Improved Shadow Bolt and Ruin, the Affliction preset until now, stays as Affliction Shadow Bolt (1015.6 as an Orc).

lines.title: Destruction is the warlock's default build, in place of Demonology
lines.note: It is now the warlock's highest build at 180 s.

lines.title: Clearcasting stays up when Arcane Missiles is cast on Missile Barrage; Ignite takes Flamestrike's burn
lines.note: Within noise on every preset (none casts Flamestrike).

source.label: Blizzard: WoW Forever Beta Development Notes, updated November 2

lines.title: Arcane mage: Fireball as the filler, Arcane Blast on Clearcasting and with spare mana; talents re-picked (Arcane Meditation 3, Incineration 5)
lines.note: Arcane used to end fights with about 5000 mana unspent. At 180 s: 937.5 to 962.3.

lines.title: Fire mage refreshes Fire Vulnerability with Scorch under 9 sec left (was 5)
Every race has Classic's base attributes
lines.note: A Tauren warrior has 5 more Strength than a Human, for example. The notes give no numbers for the two Skyborne races, so they keep their earlier offsets. Most presets move by under 1 DPS.

source.label: Blizzard: WoW Forever Beta Development Notes, updated November 2

lines.title: Read Leyline is a 0.5 sec cast (was 2 sec) and can't be used under Innervate
lines.note: The Innervate rule is from the November 2 notes.

lines.title: Blessing of Salvation is gone from the raid buffs
lines.note: Salvation, Mass Salvation and Revoke were removed from the game. Salvation only lowered threat, so no preset's damage moves.

source.label: Blizzard: WoW Forever Beta Development Notes, updated November 2

lines.title: Feral cat throws an EZ-Thro Dark Bomb at 60 Energy or less right after a main hand swing, and uses Rake and Shadowmeld Ravage at 5 combo points too
lines.note: +8.0 at 180 s; the Faerie Fire duty build takes the bomb too (+6.2).

lines.title: Balance druid casts Wrath when the mana for Starfire isn't there, and no longer has a separate Clearcasting Starfire line
lines.note: +0.7 at 180 s, the Skyborne races' rotations too.

lines.title: Twist and sub-Holy paladins use Holy Strike ahead of Judgement and the seals
lines.note: +1.2 and +1.4 at 180 s. The duty builds and the vs Undead build keep their rotation.

lines.title: Chain Lightning's spell power coefficient is now 0.714, the standard one for its new 2.5 sec cast
lines.note: Chain Lightning still stays out of the single-target rotations, so no shaman number moves.

lines.title: Rogue server hotfix: Shank always hits and no longer procs poisons or weapon effects, Mutilate's flat damage raised to 44 / 63 / 88, Venom's extra poison chance covers only Deadly and Wound Poison, talent tree layout updated
lines.note: Improved Distract is gone and several talents moved column; Quick Getaway now needs Dirty Tricks, so Subtlety's point moves there. The poisons' charges went up too, which moves no number. At 180 s: Combat Swords 963.5 to 958.6, Seal Fate Swords 957.0 to 940.4, Combat Daggers 946.7 to 949.8, Seal Fate Daggers 920.7 to 903.4, Subtlety 881.7 to 881.3, Mutilate 866.1 to 858.3.

lines.title: Warrior hotfix: Raging Blows removed, Reckless Swings on a 1 sec global cooldown, Spearing Strike 75% (plus 75% against Giants and Dragonkin)
lines.note: Fury loses the Raging Blows point and takes it in Improved Bloodrage (dual wield) or Booming Voice (two-hand). Reckless Swings now waits for the main strikes: every preset casts it just ahead of Heroic Strike, and two-hand Fury and Arms only under 20 Rage.

lines.title: Unbridled Wrath triggers on auto attacks only, not Heroic Strike or Cleave
lines.note: Fury and Arms lose Rage and damage they were getting from Unbridled Wrath procs on Heroic Strike and Cleave. Fury down 1.4 to 2.2% at 180 s, Arms 1% or less.

lines.title: Bloodrage and Reckless Swings cost health only on a tank
lines.note: The sim heals no DPS player, so the costs ran a DPS warrior's health to 0 and Berserker Rage fired as a survival cooldown. DPS warriors now pay nothing; tanks still do.

lines.title: New assumption: a swing that doesn't land uses no Reckless Swings charge
lines.note: Whether a miss, dodge or parry uses one of the four charges is decided server side. The other reading costs dual-wield Fury about 2.6 DPS and Fury 2H and Arms nothing.

lines.title: Meditation adds to casting Mana regeneration instead of replacing it
lines.note: It wiped the Vestments of Transcendence 3-piece bonus; Shadow priests are within 0.3 DPS of before.

lines.title: Divine Favor and Oath of Light get no Benediction discount; Libram of Holy Alacrity from the client
lines.note: Benediction's spell mask doesn't reach either spell, so Divine Favor costs its full 4% of base mana.

lines.title: Gear re-spent on each spec's hit steps: rogues, dual-wield Fury, Enhancement, Retribution twist, Feral cat, Arcane and Destruction fire
lines.note: Where a talent or racial gives hit, the set wears the step that puts hit just at the cap instead of past it, and the spare points go to other stats. Feral cat up 2.3%, twist Retribution up 1%. Every other race wears the step that puts its own hit at the cap, up or down.

lines.title: Mana gained is no longer multiplied when it makes threat
lines.note: The sim now counts threat from mana gains without the class's threat multiplier, as the wowsims Forever sim does (not yet confirmed in game), so threat per second is lower for classes that gain mana in combat. Damage per second is unchanged.

lines.title: Comparisons are simmed to a luck goal, with a random stream for each kind of roll
lines.note: Race, racial and assumption rows run extra fights until the difference with the row they are compared to is within a set error, and two sims that differ in one setting share every other roll. Every number moves by about its error; the race and assumption rows carry far less noise.

lines.title: Feral cat throws a Goblin Sapper Charge: explosives can be used in Cat and Bear Form
lines.note: The client flags the sapper and the land mine as usable while shapeshifted, so the cat takes the sapper on cooldown.

lines.title: Hotfix: Ferocious Bite's extra-Energy damage raised to 0.7 / 1.2 / 1.8 / 2.5 / 3.1 / 3.3 a point (was 0.6 / 1.0 / 1.5 / 2.0 / 2.5 / 2.7)
lines.note: One rank per Ferocious Bite rank 1 to 6. Feral cat is up 0.1 DPS at 180 s.

title: Launch hotfix: paladin and druid talent reworks

source.label: foreverchanges.pro: a hotfix to the October 30 build

lines.title: Two-handed warriors' critical white hits give twice the swing's Rage (was 77% more)
lines.note: Combat logs show a two-handed white crit at exactly twice the Rage of a normal swing. The sim added the 100% bonus at the one-handed rate. One-handed and off-hand crits were already double.

lines.title: Paladin talents reworked: Unsealed Wrath replaces Twist of Light, Conviction is 2% crit a rank with everything, Holy Power only crits heals
lines.note: Unsealed Wrath stores the active seal on each landed swing (up to 3 copies) and spends them on the first swing under another seal. Seals no longer cost 20% less, and Vindication no longer raises attack power. Every paladin talent string changed.

lines.title: Retribution presets re-picked for the new trees, twisting seals through Unsealed Wrath
lines.note: Twist up 65 (974.5 to 1039.3) and sub-Holy 60 (977.9 to 1038.1), Ret Shock up 14 (960.6 to 974.9); the deep Holy Shock build drops 53 (908.4 to 855.6) and now takes a Dragonfire Potion. Undead stays the best race.

lines.title: Druid talents reworked: Berserk and Improved Shifting Power removed, Shifting Power on an 8 sec cooldown, Genesis and Naturalist 2% a point
lines.note: Predatory Discipline lets Ferocious Bite keep its extra Energy, and Bite has a new rank 1. Every druid talent string changed.

lines.title: Druid presets re-picked for the new trees
lines.note: Feral takes Furor and Blood Frenzy where Berserk was: up 57 (885.6 to 942.5). Balance and Wrath keep their talents in the new layout and gain from Genesis and Naturalist: up 45 (846.6 to 891.1) and 49 (806.5 to 855.7).

lines.title: Moonkin Aura and Leader of the Pack give 3% crit with spells and attacks, and only one of them counts
lines.note: Feral gains 0.2 from its own aura's spell crit; Balance is unchanged.

lines.title: Hunter tree: Pathfinding and Improved Revive Pet moved
lines.note: The Beast Mastery presets' Pathfinding point goes to Improved Aspect of the Monkey. No DPS change.

lines.title: Frost mage values restored: Ice Lance does 4 times damage to Frozen targets (was 3), Frigid Power 15% (was 3%), Ice Barrier 5% while shielded (was 3%), Winter's Chill 20% a stack (was 5%)
lines.note: Frostfire gains 30 on the same talents (1046.3 to 1076.6).

lines.title: Arcane Blast: 12% of Intellect, +100% mana a stack, 18 sec
lines.note: Server hotfix, not in the development notes. On its old talents and rotation Arcane lost 17.

lines.title: Frost and Arcane mage presets re-picked; Fire and Frostfire keep theirs
lines.note: Frost goes 16/4/31, keeps Ice Barrier up all fight and takes Incineration over Arcane Blast, now as High Order: up 37 (907.8 to 944.9). Arcane spends the cheaper stacks' mana on Arcane Wrath on cooldown: up 28 (910.9 to 939.0).

lines.title: The deep Holy Shock paladin build is no longer in the report, with its Judgement duty and vs Undead versions
lines.note: Ret Shock (deep Holy), 31 points in Holy to Light's Vigil, fell 17.7% behind Ret twist with the talent rework (855.6 at 180 s). Ret Shock, Holy Shock with most points in Retribution, stays.

lines.title: Frostfire is the mage's default build, in place of Fire
lines.note: Frostfire does 1076.6 at 180 s against Fire's 1056.4. Fire stays a preset.

lines.title: Marksmanship and Lone Wolf cast Aimed Shot again while mana is above 40%
lines.note: Below 40% mana Multi-Shot takes the shared cooldown, as before. Up 2 to 3 at 180 s (Marksmanship 1063.7 to 1066.4, Lone Wolf 1087.4 to 1090.0), 6 to 8 at 120 s, even at 300 s. Survival and Beast Mastery keep their rotations.

lines.title: Lightning Overload's extra bolts no longer trigger Judgement of Wisdom or Elemental Devastation
lines.note: The extra bolt counts as a proc in the game data, and those effects don't fire from procs, as with Fire Nova. Elemental loses a little mana from Judgement of Wisdom: 768.5 to 768.4 at 180 s, 753.2 to 752.8 with Mana Tide.

lines.title: Two-hand Fury uses Berserker Rage only under 10 Rage and Slams from 60 Rage
lines.note: Was under 30 and from 45. Berserker Rage's global cooldown goes to a Hamstring instead, and with the bigger crit Rage Slam's swing delay is needed less often. About +5 at every length (1078.2 to 1083.9 at 120 s on the base build).

lines.title: Dual-wield Fury drinks its pull Mighty Rage Potion only when a second one fits
lines.note: In a fight under about 135 s the pull potion's 2 min cooldown cost the one with Death Wish and Recklessness. Up 1 to 2 at 120 s, the same at 180 and 300 s.

lines.title: Arms on Sunder duty Slams ahead of Mortal Strike
lines.note: The duty's Sunders take global cooldowns, and a wait costs Slam's 15 s cooldown more than Mortal Strike's 6 s. Up about 2 at every length (968.0 to 970.4 at 180 s).

lines.title: Rogues use their builders whenever they can afford them, without timing them after a swing
lines.note: Forever's extra attacks don't reset the swing timer, so a proc's free swing is the same wherever the builder lands, and waiting only delays it. At 180 s: Combat Swords 777.0 to 782.1, Seal Fate Swords 743.2 to 747.1, Combat Daggers 788.9 to 790.8, Seal Fate Daggers 751.4 to 752.9, Mutilate 742.7 to 743.8, Subtlety 732.1 to 732.9. Every build stays Undead.

lines.title: Combat Daggers stops pooling Energy, drops Vanish into Ambush and Preparation, and refreshes Slice and Dice in its last second
lines.note: Part of its gain above. Seal Fate Daggers keeps the Vanish and the 3 sec refresh, now as its own rotation.

lines.title: Demonology wears a gear set of its own, built for its own stat target
lines.note: It wore the Destruction and Affliction set, which is short of the crit a Demonology warlock gears for. Up 7.2 at 180 s (1045.5 to 1052.7). Orc stays its best race.

lines.title: Casters stand at the longest range all of their spells reach
lines.note: Distance sets how long every bolt flies. Frostfire and Arcane stand at 20 yd for Fire Blast, Shadow at 22 for Mind Flay, Fire, Frost, Smite and the warlocks at 30, Balance at 36 with Nature's Reach; Elemental stays at 20. Most builds move by under 2 DPS at 180 s. Balance Wrath loses about 7, since a Wrath now flies longer than it casts, and Arcane no longer ends on Arcane Explosion.

lines.title: Balance Wrath is a Night Elf
lines.note: At 36 yd haste shortens the cast but not the flight, so the Skyborne races fall behind: Night Elf 853.0 against Windshaper's 848.3 at 180 s. It holds Elune's Light for the trinket, as Balance does. Windshaper stays the best Horde race.

lines.title: Beast Mastery hunters start the fight at 12 yd
lines.note: Just outside Auto Shot's dead zone, where the weave starts anyway. Up 1.5 at 180 s (1045.4 to 1046.9). Marksmanship and Lone Wolf gain nothing from it and stay at 25 yd.

lines.title: Ice Lance and Fire Blast share a cooldown
lines.note: The game files put Ice Lance's 8 sec cooldown in the same category as Fire Blast's, so casting either puts both on cooldown. Frostfire, the one preset that casts both, drops 11.7 at 180 s (1076.0 to 1064.3).

lines.title: Ranged hunters no longer carry the Goblin Sapper Charge
lines.note: It only goes off within 10 yd, which a ranged hunter reaches only mid-weave. Down 0.1 to 0.4 at 180 s. Survival keeps it.

lines.title: Affliction is an Orc
lines.note: Orc 1013.6 against Human's 1012.7 at 180 s. Human stays the best Alliance race.

lines.title: Warlocks time their second Bane of Doom for the 2 minute cooldowns
lines.note: Bane of Doom deals its damage in one tick a minute later, on the stats the warlock has when it lands. Holding the second Doom one second past its cooldown makes that tick land after the trinket and Blood Fury come back. Up 0.6 to 2.2 at 180 s. The curse duty presets already cast it late enough.

title: Melee rotations tuned for extra attacks

lines.title: Retribution paladins twist seals whenever no Echo is waiting, not only in the last 1.5 sec before a swing
lines.note: Since extra attacks stopped resetting the swing timer, the open window puts both seals on more swings. Against Undead bosses the 1.5 sec window still does better and stays; the Holy Shock builds don't twist.

lines.title: Arms and two-hand Fury warriors use Hamstring from 10 Rage (was 30 and 20)
lines.note: More Hamstrings means more Windfury Totem and sword procs, which pay for themselves now that extra attacks keep the swing timer.

lines.title: Frost mage preset is Undead (was High Order)
lines.note: After the talent rework Undead edges out High Order on Frost.

lines.title: Efficiency also lowers Strider Kick's mana cost
Method: the Windfury Totem and extra attack answers now match the numbers (0.1 sec, the swing timer kept), and Eviscerate's 4% attack power a combo point has its own answer
lines.note: Text only: the numbers already used these since the last update.

lines.title: The raid's Sunder Armor builds up from the pull, no longer full at the pull
lines.note: A warrior tank adds a stack every global cooldown and a second warrior casts one on its first, so the boss is at 5 stacks 4.5 sec in. A warrior preset is that second warrior. It costs physical builds up to 4 DPS. Holding cooldowns for the fifth stack was tested and lost DPS, so the rotations still open with them.

lines.title: Goblin Sapper Charge and Goblin Land Mine only hit enemies within 10 yards
lines.note: The sim used them from any range. Ranged hunters still set off the Sapper when they step in to melee weave. Mages, Balance druids, Elemental shamans, warlocks and priests now take no Sapper. It costs them 4 to 9 DPS.

lines.title: Ranged hunters throw the EZ-Thro Dark Bomb instead of laying the Goblin Land Mine
lines.note: From range the mine's blast can't reach the boss, and its 1 sec cast doesn't fit in a melee weave.

lines.title: Warlocks and priests cast from 25 yards, like mages (was 5)
lines.note: That puts them out of the Sapper's reach, and their bolts now take their flight time.

lines.title: Method: the hunters' notes now say Improved Tracking counts against the generic boss, unlike Murder and the other creature-type talents
lines.note: Text only: the numbers already counted it. A hunter can track every raid boss type except Mechanical, and the talent is worth 4 to 5% to the hunters who take it.

lines.title: Hunter pets no longer have Pet Aggression (+8 damage a hit)
lines.note: No pet trainer teaches it in Forever: Beast Training doesn't list it, as in Classic, where pets never learned it. Cobra Reflexes is now about even and stays.

lines.title: Hunter pets' normal swings hit 30% less before attack power
lines.note: The game's creature damage figure already includes the pet's own attack power, and the sim was adding that attack power on top. 152 logged hits of a level 30 Cat fit the new figure.

lines.title: Mage talents reworked: Arcane Focus removed, Critical Mass down to 3 points (6% Fire crit), Incineration up to 5 points (10%)
lines.note: Improved Fireball is now Accelerant and also shortens Arcane Wrath's cast. Missile Barrage, Arcane Resilience, Improved Channeling and Improved Fire Blast moved in the tree, so every mage talent string changed.

lines.title: Elemental Precision is now Precision: 2/4/6% hit with all spells, Arcane included
Ice Lance has an 8 sec cooldown
lines.note: The game files put it on rank 1 only; the presets give every rank the cooldown, as the tooltip does. Assumed until checked in game.

lines.title: Mage presets: talents re-picked for the new trees
lines.note: Fire and Arcane put the freed points in Incineration; Frostfire in Incineration and Master of Elements; Frost in Arcane Concentration, Arcane Meditation and Arcane Wrath.

lines.title: Frost mage: three Arcane Blast stacks and no Evocation
lines.note: With Ice Lance on a cooldown, the mana goes further.

lines.title: Arcane mage: keeps four Arcane Blast stacks at low mana

title: Rotations that hold at any fight length

lines.title: Night Elf warriors: Elune's Light with the other cooldowns, not in Recklessness
Fury: Recklessness waits for the last Death Wish in long fights
Frostfire: no longer runs out of mana in 3 to 4 minute fights
lines.note: Evocation and the cheaper Frostfire Bolt start 75 sec before the end.

lines.title: Fire: Berserking and Blood Fury wait for 5 Fire Vulnerability stacks
Troll warlocks: Berserking waits for the first Shadow Bolt or Incinerate
Gnome warlocks on curse duty: Eureka! saved for the spells it boosts
Elemental: lower-rank Lightning Bolt only when mana won't last the fight
Holy Shock Paladin: Light's Vigil down to 30% mana in every fight
lines.note: In fights over 3.5 minutes it stopped at 60%.

lines.title: Holy Shock Paladin vs Undead: Light's Vigil saves mana when it would run out
Dwarf Smite Priest: no Chastise against Humanoids
lines.note: Its global cooldown deals more as Smite.

lines.title: Troll Shadow Priests: Shadowguard shown as its own racial
lines.note: The raid damage hits set it off, worth 8.7 DPS on Shadow and 8.3 on Shadow + Holy. The race breakdown counted it in the Troll's base stats.

lines.title: Dwarf: Artisan's Precision includes the gear it frees up
lines.note: A Dwarf's gear trades the hit Artisan's Precision makes spare for other stats. The race breakdown now measures base stats on the preset's gear, so Dwarf base stats match a Tauren's and Precision's bar includes the trade: 5.6 DPS on Fury 2H (it showed 13.1). Race totals don't change.

lines.title: Windfury Totem shown up all fight; its proc is Windfury Attack
lines.note: The aura list showed only each proc's 1 second attack power buff, under the totem's name, at about 9% uptime. The totem is now listed at 100%, and the proc's buff as Windfury Attack. No DPS changes.

lines.title: Feral Faerie Fire duty: Faerie Fire in Cat Form is the caster spell
lines.note: Forever has no Faerie Fire (Feral). In Cat Form the druid casts the caster Faerie Fire, free there but on a 1.5 second global cooldown, so keeping it up costs 8.3 DPS at 180 seconds (it was 4.5).

lines.title: New duty presets: Judgement of the Crusader, Judgement of Wisdom, Sunder Armor and Curse of Recklessness
lines.note: Ret paladins that keep Judgement of the Crusader or Judgement of Wisdom up on the boss, warriors that keep 5 Sunder Armor stacks up for a raid with no warrior tank, and warlocks on Curse of Recklessness. They show with Duty on, with what the duty costs.

lines.title: New hunter presets with a wolf or a tallstrider
lines.note: Beast Mastery, Marksmanship and Survival with a wolf (Furious Howl) or a tallstrider (Dust Cloud) in place of the cat. They show with Duty on, with what the pet costs.

lines.title: Extra attacks no longer restart the swing timer
lines.note: Windfury Totem, Hack and Slash, Sword Specialization, Hand of Justice and other extra attacks swing at once, and the next swing comes when it was already due. Assumed until a combat log settles it.

lines.title: Windfury Totem can proc again 0.1 sec after a proc, not 1.5 sec
Eviscerate: 4% of attack power per combo point, up from 3%
lines.note: Taken from in-game tests by the WoWSims Forever team. Assumed until our own test settles it.

lines.title: Sharpening stones only work on edged weapons, and weightstones on blunt ones
Combat Swords and Combat Daggers: Dense Weightstone on the off-hand mace
lines.note: The same +8 damage as the sharpening stone they listed, which can't go on a mace.

title: Hunter hotfix: Trueshot Aura and Aspect of the Hawk

lines.title: Trueshot Aura and Aspect of the Hawk about halved at lower ranks
lines.note: Server hotfix, not in the development notes. Best at 60: Trueshot Aura rank 5 (+50 ranged attack power) and Aspect of the Hawk rank 6 (+55).

lines.title: High Order Frostfire and Arcane: rotations built around Wind Blessed
Troll Elemental: Berserking right after Elemental Mastery
Night Elf Fury: Elune's Light at the pull
Gnome warlocks: Eureka! timed to cover the spells it boosts

title: Blood Fury, Berserking and Touch of the Grave

lines.title: Orc: Blood Fury cooldown 2 min (was 3 min)
Troll: Berserking lasts 15 sec (was 10 sec)
Undead: Touch of the Grave every 15 sec (was 25 sec)
Presets moved to their best race
lines.note: Shadow to Undead; Combat Daggers, Seal Fate Daggers, Combat Swords and Subtlety to Undead; Enhancement to Orc; Demonology and Destruction to Orc; Destruction Fire to Undead.

lines.title: Races get their own rotation where it does better
lines.note: High Order and Windshaper casters, Troll, Orc and Undead Frostfire, Gnome rogues (Eureka!), and Holy Fire Smite for 5 races.

lines.title: Dwarves trade hit over the cap for other stats
lines.note: On 14 presets: hunters, Retribution, Shadow, Elemental, Arms and 2H Fury.

lines.title: Presets moved to their best race
lines.note: Beast Mastery, Marksmanship and Survival to Orc; Lone Wolf and Balance to Night Elf; Balance Wrath to Windshaper; Arcane to Gnome; every Retribution preset to Undead; dagger rogues to Gnome; Mutilate and Seal Fate Swords to Undead; Enhancement to Windshaper; Arms to Undead.

lines.title: Retribution Shock (deep Holy): retuned rotation
lines.note: Consecration and Light's Vigil timing.

lines.title: Retribution Shock vs Undead and Crusader duty: Light's Vigil retimed
Human: Ruthless 1% crit (was 2%), The Human Spirit 10% Spirit (was 5%)
Dwarf: Earth Fury (2% crit damage) replaced by Artisan's Precision (1% hit)
Tauren: Endurance loses its 2% crit damage
Orc: Savage (1% crit) replaced by Command (5% more pet damage)
Skyborne: Wind Blessed 2% haste (was 3%), Read Leyline weaker
lines.note: Read Leyline: 50% more Spirit regen for 15 sec (was 100% for 30 sec).

lines.title: Warlock: Spellstone boosts Shadow only, not Fire
Mage: Arcane Missiles no longer procs Missile Barrage
lines.note: The talent's text no longer lists Arcane Missiles.

lines.title: Mage: Arcane Instability and Arcane Power no longer boost Ignite
lines.note: No preset takes Ignite with them.
